name: Boomdandy
ability: If you are executed, all but 3 players die. After a 10 to 1 countdown, the player with the most players pointing at them, dies.
interaction: Nothing; on execution all players (alive and dead) point during a countdown.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned when executed, nothing happens; the Boomdandy just dies normally.

jinxes.text: If the Storyteller would gain the Boomdandy ability, a player becomes the Boomdandy.

rulings.text: Only execution triggers it; other deaths (Golem, Psychopath) do not.
If executed but surviving (e.g. Devil's Advocate) it still explodes.
The Demon always survives the explosion; the Storyteller chooses the other two survivors.
If a survivor cannot die (Fool, Sailor) the Storyteller may leave four players alive.
All players, including dead ones without a vote token, may point; pointing may change until the countdown ends.
A tie: nobody dies, the day ends and night falls.

test_scenarios.name: explosion, evil wins
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Amy Boomdandy, Ben Po, Cal Widow, Dee Fortune Teller, Eli Chef, Fay Empath, Gus Monk.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Amy executed. Storyteller keeps Ben, Cal, Dee alive. Pointing: Cal gets most fingers.
test_scenarios.expected: Amy, Eli, Fay, Gus die; then Cal dies; two players remain with the Demon alive -> evil wins.

test_scenarios.name: explosion, good wins
test_scenarios.actions: After the explosion, most fingers point at Ben (Po).

test_scenarios.name: tie
test_scenarios.actions: Pointing is tied between Cal and Dee.
test_scenarios.expected: Nobody dies from pointing; night falls immediately.
